platform_mapping_limits.provider_aggregation: POST /*_meet_list/_search terms-agg on 'tna' FAILS on 250/256 shards: illegal_argument_exception 'Text fields are not optimised for ... Please use a keyword field instead ... fielddata=true on [tna]'. No keyword subfield exists. Per-provider meet counts are therefore NOT obtainable from the shared cluster in one request.
platform_mapping_limits.state_aggregation: terms-agg on 'lsa' (text) fails the same way; 'lsa.keyword' works and returns 70 buckets.
platform_mapping_limits.workaround: enumerate tenants via _index agg (256), then count providers by fetching docs per tenant or by reading the tenant name as a provider proxy.
